en: A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a busy lakeside bathing area surrounded by dense forest. In the foreground many people sit or lie on deckchairs and benches along the sandy shore, some wrapped in towels, others in swimsuits. Children and adults wade and swim in the lake. In the middle distance a wooden pier stretches out into the water, with ladders, diving structures and a slide where numerous bathers are gathered. Trees line the entire far shore under a partly cloudy sky. The caption at the bottom left reads "Schmannewitz/Sa. - Bad Waldteich".
